note: grok 1.0.70 (f50904eaee6c) [stable]. Prompt: List the files in this directory and say hello. Prompt path: the message goes in argv as `--single=<message>` (the long form of `-p`; a separate value starting with `-` is refused by clap); 1.0.70's headless mode does not read the prompt from stdin, so a prompt over 100,000 bytes is written to `<stagingDir>/message.md` and passed with `--prompt-file`, and a persona over that size is prepended to the message under `# Role` since `--rules` takes text only. Errors observed on 1.0.70: without a login (an empty GROK_HOME) the stream is one line `{"type":"error","message":"Not signed in. To authenticate without a browser, run:\n  grok login --device-code ..."}`, stderr repeats it after `Error: `, exit 1, classified `auth`; an unknown model and a refused effort level are `error` lines too, classified `exit`. No usage-limit message has been observed. Redacted after capture: home directory and username, the LICENSE author's name (also inside streamed text chunks), session and request ids replaced with placeholders.
